title: How to play Knight
author: Guff
html:
Knights are the dedicated frontline of Sword x Staff, built around blocking incoming hits and converting them into reflected damage through Rebound Rebound KnightCharmCounterstrike Description Each time the caster blocks an enemy's Technique attack, deals Physical DMG once to the attacker based on the caster's DEF. , while also capable of switching to a Glass Cannon setup for boss fights when someone else handles the tanking.

Knight strengths & weaknesses

  • ✓Rebound is exceptionally good against multi-hit enemies and AoE packs
  • ✓One of the safest classes for pushing large combat power gaps thanks to consistent blocking and multiple defensive layers
  • ✓Glass Cannon option allows you to switch to a DPS build for content where someone is already tanking
  • ✕Annoying stat priorities compared to pure DPS classes
  • ✕Glass Cannon requires favorable conditions to use safely: either a dedicated tank present or low incoming pressure from monsters
Experiment with builds!

Remember these are just boilerplates to change based on your gear, playstyle, skills and Fantomons.

Best stats

Knights have two distinct stat priorities depending on which build you are running.

For the Reflect Tank, your damage scales through consistent blocking. Block % and Block Rate are required to function, and Physical Mastery drives the damage that Rebound Rebound KnightCharmCounterstrike Description Each time the caster blocks an enemy's Technique attack, deals Physical DMG once to the attacker based on the caster's DEF. reflects back to our enemies.

After those, Defense %, Flat Defense, and elemental resistances extend your survivability even more.

For the Glass Cannon build, treat your stats the same as any physical DPS. Physical Mastery first, then Crit Rate and Crit Damage, followed by Attack % and Flat Attack.

A few notes that apply to both builds:

  • Damage Increase and Damage Reduction are strong stats but mostly come from systems outside gear, do not chase them on gear directly
  • Elemental Aegis is a strong defensive stat, but also largely comes from other systems, so it is not something you will target on gear
  • Effect Hit and Effect Resistance have limited value right now and are not worth prioritizing over the other core stats
  • Crit Resistance is unnecessary for the Reflect Tank. A blocked hit cannot critically strike, making Block a more efficient defensive investment

Fantomons

Nyxarchon is the best option for the Glass Cannon build thanks to the extra charm slot and higher base stats.

For actual tanks, Armopi becomes the default pet since the extra shield it provides (and the DEF buff) is really good on any defensive loadout. If you are unlucky with your pulls, Boaro can work until you get Armopi .

Companions

Companions give passive stats at specific levels, so we recommend focusing on a few until level 50 that benefit your class directly before you level up all of them.

ALL CLASSES benefit from DMG Boost and Reduction stats to both increase damage and survivability.

For the Reflect Tank, prioritize companions that provide Block Rate like Braulio , Darkness or Mayoi .

For the Glass Cannon, prioritize Attack and Physical Mastery to keep your damage output competitive. Akane , Hermes , Jiangwang and Ophelia are good picks here.

Gems

Gem tiers

I’m going to use T10 gems as a reference, but the higher the tier, the better the stats they provide. Gems go from T1 to T15.

T10 Obsidian T10 Obsidian Description Inlay gear with it to amplify your ATK and DMG Boost. is good on any class, since everyone benefits from more damage regardless of what playstyle they have.

T10 Moonstone T10 Moonstone Description Inlay gear with it to amplify your DEF and DMG RES. is also pretty popular for all classes to help increase their survivability.

For Knights, T10 Sapphire T10 Sapphire Description Inlay gear with it to amplify your DEF. is a great choice to increase your DEF and T10 Beryl T10 Beryl Description Inlay gear with it to amplify your HP. can help with extra HP.

If you are going for the glass cannon build, simply focusing on offensive gems is the way to go with T10 Ruby T10 Ruby Description Inlay gear with it to amplify your ATK. and T10 Amethyst T10 Amethyst Description Inlay gear with it to amplify your SPD and Crit Rate. .

Builds

Early on you are limited by the amount of techniques available, but Warriors have solid options for both AoE and single target right from the start.

Block Rate is surprisingly powerful here, investing in it early can make you feel nearly untouchable in a lot of content compared to Mages.

The Knight introduces your new best friend Rebound Rebound KnightCharmCounterstrike Description Each time the caster blocks an enemy's Technique attack, deals Physical DMG once to the attacker based on the caster's DEF. , which will convert blocks into reflected damage. This is when the class starts to function the way it was designed.

This will also be your go-to build for most content.

IMPORTANT NOTES

Group content: Heart of Challenge Heart of Challenge KnightTechniqueAttackDebuff Description Deals Physical DMG once to all enemies within 3 grids of the caster, with an 85% chance to inflict Taunt for 1 turn. Has a 100% chance to inflict Taunt non-character units. (Casts once before battle starts.) is mandatory for the Reflect Tank in party play. Without it you lose control over what is hitting you and Rebound Rebound KnightCharmCounterstrike Description Each time the caster blocks an enemy's Technique attack, deals Physical DMG once to the attacker based on the caster's DEF. triggers less reliably.

Block Rate is now critical: Your damage output depends on landing blocks consistently. Make sure you are investing in it on gear and charms.

Physical Mastery: The primary way Rebound Rebound KnightCharmCounterstrike Description Each time the caster blocks an enemy's Technique attack, deals Physical DMG once to the attacker based on the caster's DEF. scales its reflected damage. Do not neglect it on gear even in the tank build.

Each block triggers Rebound Rebound KnightCharmCounterstrike Description Each time the caster blocks an enemy's Technique attack, deals Physical DMG once to the attacker based on the caster's DEF. once, so the build is especially strong against multi-hit attacks, AoE packs, and enemies that attack rapidly in sequences.

A single skill that hits 5 times will trigger Rebound Rebound KnightCharmCounterstrike Description Each time the caster blocks an enemy's Technique attack, deals Physical DMG once to the attacker based on the caster's DEF. 5 separate times.

The Palading class upgrade expands your toolkit significantly and introduces the Glass Cannon build as a viable alternative for boss content.

The Reflect Tank remains your strongest general setup, but now you have the flexibility to pivot depending on what the fight demands.

Warrior's Essence

Boss damage build when survivability is not required. Use this when a dedicated tank is already present or incoming damage is low enough that tanking is not needed.

Focus entirely on maximizing total damage output through buffs and debuffs. In boss fights where damage is measured over a fixed number of turns, this build will outperform the Reflect Tank significantly.
